scope: All 100 cases remaining metadata-only in tlm-138-preview-consolidated-triage-20261111.v1.json after previous 15-case source review.
policy: RESEARCH_ONLY: 100 photo candidates visually audited; openable Commons page does NOT mean current photo licence or exact site is independently verified. All rights/author values not explicitly checked remain archive claims. Do not publish without source/identity/visual policy and editorial checks.
method: All 100 archive previews viewed on prior 157-photo contact sheets; 99/100 individual Commons URLs attempted. 61 Commons file pages browsable; individually read photographer and current licence lines for 21 (not a blanket approval), backed by independently available first-party/diocesan evidence where explicitly recorded. 39 pages inaccessible or unconfirmed. Source SHA1 was historical P739 metadata; live original SHA1 was not independently retrieved in this pass. Five policy lane holds and eight subject/composition holds; all other statuses preserve outstanding source/identity/rights requirements.
